entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. How can I help you today?
I need to return something. I bought a VeloBand Pulse a couple of weeks ago and it's just not working out for me.
I understand. I'm happy to help you with a return. Could you please provide me with your order number or the email address associated with your VeloFit account?
It's order number VP-789456. And hurry up, I don't have all day!
Thank you. Let me pull up your order details. Okay, I see here that you purchased a VeloBand Pulse on July 10th. To confirm, you are looking to return this smart watch?
Yes, the VeloBand Pulse. That's exactly what I said! It's been giving me inaccurate readings and it's just generally a pain to use. What's your return policy?

Our return policy allows for returns within 90 days of purchase, as long as the item is in good condition. Since you bought it on July 10th, you are well within that window. I apologize for any inconvenience the VeloBand Pulse has caused.
Ninety days? Seriously? That's it? Finally, some good news. So how do I get my money back?

I can process a full refund for you right now. I'll send you a prepaid shipping label to your email address associated with your account. Simply repackage the VeloBand Pulse in its original packaging, attach the label, and drop it off at any authorized carrier location.
Okay, that sounds easy enough. Will I get the refund as soon as you get the watch back?

Yes, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method once we receive the returned VeloBand Pulse and verify its condition. You should see it reflected in your account within 7-10 business days after that. The 90 days is there to give you ample time for any returns like these.
Perfect. Thank you! This has actually been a pretty easy process. Usually, it's a nightmare trying to return things.
You're very welcome. I'm glad I could help. We strive to make returns as smooth as possible. Is there anything else I can assist you with today regarding our products or your VeloFit account?
No, I think that's everything. Thanks again for your help!
You're welcome! Have a great day!
